name: AR Bubbles
summary:
AR Bubbles – Magic in Your Living Room!

Bring the fun of soap bubbles into your world with AR Bubbles! Experience the joy of popping bubbles with your fingers or blowing them away to merge with others.

Ever seen red bubbles or heart-shaped ones? Now you can!

Create gigantic, elongated bubbles, cast a beautiful rainbow, or watch as a butterfly gently lands on your hand.

With AR Bubbles, the magic of bubbles is just a tap away. Try it now and enjoy the endless fun in your own living room!
